value.rationale: Prime 3 carries the observed local obstruction for triangular D(n) pairs. The formula refines zero/nonzero obstruction into exact rational local densities depending on arbitrary 3-adic valuation, including 8/9, 1/6, 4/81 and 23/54. Such local factors are motivated inputs to counting heuristics and quantitatively separate positive local density from global Pell obstructions.
